user.title: Resideo
user.description: Choose how to connect to your Resideo account.

login.title: Sign in to Resideo
login.description: Use the same email and password as the First Alert app — Resideo's current app for these thermostats.

browser.title: Sign in with your browser
browser.description:
**1.** [**Open the Resideo sign-in page**]({url}) — but do not sign in yet.

**2. In that new tab, open the Network panel before signing in.** The sign-in code appears once, in a single request; if Network is not already recording you will have to start over. Developer tools attach per tab, so it must be that tab:
- Chrome / Edge: `F12` (Mac: `⌘⌥I`), then click **Network**
- Firefox: `⌘⌥E` (Windows/Linux: `Ctrl+Shift+E`)
- Safari: enable Settings → Advanced → "Show features for web developers", then `⌘⌥I` → **Network**

**3. Now sign in.** Afterwards the page just sits there and the address bar does not change — that is expected, and means it worked.

**4. Copy the last entry in the Network list** — greyed out / canceled, name starting `callback?code=`. Right-click → **Copy** → **Copy link address**.

**5. Paste it below.** Just the entry's name works too.

manual.title: Refresh token
manual.description: Paste a refresh_token obtained by proxying login.resideo.com.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Resideo
reauth_confirm.description: The stored credentials no longer work. Choose how to sign in again.

invalid_auth.title: Invalid email or password
invalid_auth.description:
Resideo did not accept that email and password ({detail}).

Use the same credentials as the First Alert app — Resideo's current app for these thermostats. If they are certainly right, two things can cause this:

- **Resideo is refusing the direct sign-in** — a CAPTCHA or a temporary rate limit, not a wrong password. **Signing in with your browser** gets past that.
- **Your account is still on Resideo's older login.** The app now called **Resideo** on your phone (formerly **Honeywell Home**) uses a separate, older sign-in this integration can't use. Move your thermostat to the First Alert app by following [Resideo's instructions]({migration_url}), then try again. (A thermostat that only ever lived on the old Lyric system — like a Lyric Round — won't work here even after you migrate.)

invalid_token.title: Refresh token rejected
invalid_token.description:
Resideo rejected that refresh token ({detail}) — it has most likely expired or been revoked.

Grab a fresh one, or sign in another way.

captcha_required.title: Resideo asked for a CAPTCHA
captcha_required.description:
Resideo is asking for a CAPTCHA ({detail}), which Home Assistant cannot solve on its own.

**Sign in with your browser** instead — you drive the page yourself there, so the CAPTCHA is simply part of signing in.

too_many_attempts.title: Too many sign-in attempts
too_many_attempts.description:
Resideo has temporarily blocked this account or IP address after repeated attempts ({detail}).

Wait a while before trying the direct sign-in again, or **sign in with your browser**, which goes through Resideo's own page.

login_failed.title: Sign-in failed
login_failed.description:
Signing in with Resideo failed ({detail}).

This is not necessarily your password — the sign-in flow itself broke somewhere. Enable debug logging for the full response, or take one of the other paths.

invalid_code.title: No sign-in code in that address
invalid_code.description:
That does not look like the redirect address — it carries no sign-in code.

Start the browser sign-in again and copy the whole `com.resideo.firstalert://...` address, including everything after the `?`.

state_mismatch.title: That redirect is from an earlier attempt
state_mismatch.description:
That redirect belongs to an earlier sign-in attempt, so it can no longer be completed.

Start the browser sign-in again to get a fresh link.

cannot_connect.title: Could not reach Resideo
cannot_connect.description: Home Assistant could not reach Resideo at all. Check this machine's internet connection, and whether Resideo's own service is up — the First Alert app on your phone is the quickest test.

unknown.title: Unexpected error
unknown.description: Something unforeseen went wrong while signing in. The full traceback is in the Home Assistant log.

abort.no_token: No refresh token was returned by Resideo.
abort.reauth_account_mismatch: These credentials belong to a different Resideo account than the one this entry was set up with.

cloud_unavailable.title: Resideo's cloud is refusing requests
cloud_unavailable.description:
Home Assistant has not been able to reach Resideo since {since}, so your thermostats are unavailable. Every request comes back as HTTP 503, and Resideo's servers say: "{message}"

**Open the First Alert app on your phone — that tells you which of two very different problems this is.**

- **The app is failing too.** Resideo is having an outage. There is nothing to fix here: Home Assistant keeps retrying, and everything comes back on its own once Resideo recovers. Resideo publishes outages on its own status page.
- **The app still works normally.** Then Resideo has most likely retired the address this integration uses, rather than taken anything down. It did exactly that in September 2026 — the consumer API moved to a new host, and the old one went on serving this same "planned maintenance" message indefinitely. Waiting will not fix that. Check whether a newer version of the integration is available, and open an issue if there isn't one.
